weight_feedback.description: Multiplicative adjustments to weights, clamped by the recommendation loop to [0.5, 1.5] and enforced again here - scoring-service is deployed on its own port, so the clamp cannot rely on the caller.

id.description: Slug of the name; uniform across US and non-US schools.

unitid.description: Federal IPEDS UNITID where matched. US only.

country.description: Gates whether US federal enrichment can apply.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, from Scorecard STABBR. US only; null and provenance not_applicable elsewhere. Structured on purpose: `location` is display-only, so residency must never be decided by parsing it.

population.description: Student-body composition. Null for non-US schools; provenance.population reads not_applicable.

net_price_calculator_url.description: Where a student finds what they specifically would pay.

avg_sat.description: Observed only. Never derived from GPA.

net_price.description: Average annual cost after aid. Renamed from `tuition` in v2.0.0, which conflated net cost with sticker price.

sticker_tuition.description: Out-of-state tuition and fees, which is simply the price at a private school. See tuition_in_state.

tuition_in_state.description: In-state tuition and fees. US only - null and provenance not_applicable elsewhere. Identical to sticker_tuition at a private school, and less than half of it at most publics.

active_faculty.description: Researchers publishing from this school in the last three years, with what they work on. Distinct from notable_faculty, which answers who is famous here and includes people long dead. Null means nobody searched; [] means searched and found nobody. Counted from publication records, so it does not claim anyone holds a teaching appointment - it misses faculty who do not publish, and includes some research staff.

research.description: Specific research topics, e.g. 'Mathematical Dynamics and Fractals'.

fields.description: Coarse research fields, e.g. 'Mathematics'. Used to match a professor to a major.

recent_works.description: Papers written from this school since the cutoff.

last_active.description: Year of their most recent publication.

h_index.description: OpenAlex h-index - how much of their work others build on.

awards.description: Named honours, matched from the notable list. Priority is awards first, then h-index, then recent output.

notable_faculty.description: Named professors, most widely known first. Null means nobody searched (every non-US school); [] means searched and none found, which is a real answer for a small college. Carries who someone is and where to verify it - never an email or a phone number. Sourced from Wikipedia category membership plus Wikidata, so no model is involved and a professor cannot be invented.

known_for.description: One line on who they are, e.g. 'American theoretical physicist'.

fields.description: Occupations, e.g. ['physicist', 'author']. Generic academic occupations are dropped as uninformative.

status.description: historical means a recorded date of death - the person belongs in the school's story but is not teaching. Absence of a death date is not proof of tenure, which is why the values are not 'alive'/'dead'.

prominence.description: How many language Wikipedias carry an article. A measured proxy for renown, not a judgement.

awards.description: Named honours from Wikidata (P166), deduped. The strongest available signal that someone is recognised for their research; ORCID would be the natural home and is empty in practice.

programs.description: Share of degrees the school actually awards, by 2-digit CIP family, largest first. Zero shares are omitted. Null means unmeasured; an empty array means measured and awarding nothing in these families - the difference is what makes 'this school does not offer X' sayable. Never derived from the editorial `majors` list, which names strengths rather than the full catalogue.

enrollment.description: Undergraduate only, to stay comparable across sources.

culture.description: Six bipolar axes, aligned with Profile.culture_prefs. Required: it drives 18% of the score.

details.description: Curated per-school profile (scholarships, research, outcomes, graduate and professional schools). Free-form because sections are heterogeneous. Null when no profile exists - never generated filler. provenance.details records the tier.

provenance.description: Per-field origin: observed | web_verified | editorial | not_applicable | absent.

scores.description: Sorted by descending score, then ascending university_id.
